study_identification_part.si4_title: Charting brain growth and aging at high spatial precision

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: To characterize lifespan trajectories of cortical thickness and subcortical volume using normative modeling on a large neuroimaging dataset, and to showcase its clinical value by quantifying variability in a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Case-control comparisons of deviation maps and raw cortical thickness/subcortical volumes using matched control groups; Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) correction for multiple comparisons.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Normative models of brain growth and aging, applied to a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample, effectively quantify individual variability and refine case-control inferences.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: A reference cohort of 58,836 individuals (ages 2-100) from 82 sites was used for normative modeling of cortical thickness and subcortical volume. Models were validated against a manually quality-checked subset (N=24,354) and showed out-of-sample explained variance up to 80%. Application to a transdiagnostic psychiatric sample (N=1985) demonstrated their clinical value in quantifying individual variability and improving case-control inferences, with z-statistics from normative deviations yielding stronger effects than raw data for most diagnostic groups.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Limitations include the problematic nature of the term 'normative' implying normal/abnormal brains, considerable individual variability, sampling bias (predominantly WEIRD societies, 59% from UKBiobank), reliance on semi-automated QC for the full sample, and unadjusted FreeSurfer for very young age ranges (2-7 yo).
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: We view the word 'normative' as problematic. ... sampling bias. Race, education, and socioeconomic variables were not fully available for all included data sets, however, given that data were compiled from research studies, they are likely samples drawn predominantly from Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic (WEIRD) societies... The sampling bias of UKBiobank ... is especially important... we have relied on semi-automated quality control (QC) for the full sample which-despite a conservative choice of inclusion threshold-does not guarantee either that low-quality data were excluded... Freesurfer was not adjusted for the very young age ranges (2-7 yo)...

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Pretrained models and code are packaged as an open resource with an interface for transferring to new data sources, enabling subject-level predictions. Access is provided via Google Colab to remove barriers to use.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Pretrained models, code, and an example transfer dataset are openly shared on GitHub (braincharts repository), with a dedicated GitHub repository for the interactive online visualization tool (brainviz-app). Raw data for visualizations is also available on GitHub.
